## Testing Mode

## Story DD Coverage
This task satisfies:
- DD3: Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Implementation Notes
Modify plugins/dso/scripts/review-github-defense-store.sh:

github_defense_store_write: the function posts record_json as-is to PR comment (DEFENSE_RECORD: $record_json). Since story_branch_tip_sha and story_branch_base_sha are written into the record_json by defense_store_write (TrackerDefenseStore), the GitHub backend will inherit them automatically on mirroring — no structural change needed to github_defense_store_write itself.

review_mirror_defenses_to_pr: reads DEFENSE_RECORD lines from stdin and calls github_defense_store_write. Since sha fields are already embedded in record_json by the write path, no change needed here either.

However: the UNBOUND skip check must not strip sha fields. Verify by adding a test that a record with story_branch_tip_sha is posted with those fields intact.

Add test to tests/integration/test-github-defense-store.sh:
- Given a record_json with story_branch_tip_sha and story_branch_base_sha
- When github_defense_store_write is called (with GH_CMD stub)
- Then the posted comment body includes story_branch_tip_sha and story_branch_base_sha

Update .test-index with RED marker [test_github_defense_store_preserves_sha_fields].

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/review-github-defense-store.sh: modify (or verify no-op with test coverage)
- tests/integration/test-github-defense-store.sh: modify (add sha fields preservation test)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] tests/integration/test-github-defense-store.sh passes (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/integration/test-github-defense-store.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0'
- [ ] SHA fields are preserved in github_defense_store_write output
  Verify: grep -q 'test_github_defense_store_preserves_sha_fields' tests/integration/test-github-defense-store.sh

  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
